class.name: OcgBrepoffsetapiMakeoffset
class.brief_description: Describes algorithms for offsetting wires from a set of wires contained in a planar face. A MakeOffset object provides a framework for: - defining the construction of an offset, - implementing the construction algorithm, and - consulting the result.
class.description: ! Describes algorithms for offsetting wires from a set of ! wires contained in a planar face. ! A MakeOffset object provides a framework for: ! - defining the construction of an offset, ! - implementing the construction algorithm, and ! - consulting the result.

method.name: default
method.description: Constructs an algorithm for creating an empty offset

method.name: from_2
method.description: Constructs an algorithm for creating an algorithm to build parallels to the spine Spine

method.name: Init_2
method.description: Initializes the algorithm to construct parallels to the spine Spine. Join defines the type of parallel generated by the salient vertices of the spine. The default type is GeomAbs_Arc where the vertices generate sections of a circle. If join type is GeomAbs_Intersection, the edges that intersect in a salient vertex generate the edges prolonged until intersection.

method.name: SetApprox
method.description: Set approximation flag for conversion input contours into ones consisting of 2D circular arcs and 2D linear segments only.

method.name: AddWire
method.description: Initializes the algorithm to construct parallels to the wire Spine.

method.name: Perform
method.description: Computes a parallel to the spine at distance Offset and at an altitude Alt from the plane of the spine in relation to the normal to the spine. Exceptions: StdFail_NotDone if the offset is not built.

method.name: Build
method.description: Builds the resulting shape (redefined from MakeShape).

method.name: Generated
method.description: returns a list of the created shapes from the shape <S>.

method.name: ConvertFace
method.description: Converts each wire of the face into contour consisting only of arcs and segments. New 3D curves are built too.
